component.name: Bookshelf
component.summary: Your local PDF and EPUB library on a 3D bookcase

description.p: Bookshelf keeps your PDF and EPUB files on your own disk and draws them as books on a wooden bookcase. It reads them, remembers where you stopped, and never touches the files themselves.

ul.li: Import PDF and EPUB files from disk, drag-and-drop, or the file manager
A 3D bookcase that grows a new case for every shelf-full of books
Built-in readers with bookmarks, highlights, notes and full-text search
Everything offline and private: no accounts, no telemetry, no network access

description.p: First release: library, 3D shelf, PDF and EPUB readers.
